definition_en: Happening or changing slowly over a long period of time.
example_en: The weather gradually improved as the sun came out this afternoon.
example_uz: Quyosh chiqqach, ob-havo asta-sekin yaxshilandi.

definition_en: A high, very steep area of rock near the sea or mountains.
example_en: We stood at the top of the cliff and watched the ocean.
example_uz: Biz qoya tepasida turib, okeanni tomosha qildik.

definition_en: Something that most people want to have or achieve.
example_en: Fluency in a second language is a desirable skill for this job.
example_uz: Bu ish uchun ikkinchi tilni bilish ma'qul ko'riladigan mahoratdir.

definition_en: A large area of land or a system of body organs.
example_en: The city bought a large tract of land to build a park.
example_uz: Shahar park qurish uchun katta maydon sotib oldi.

definition_en: A type of classical dance performed to music with a story.
example_en: She has been practicing ballet since she was a little girl.
example_uz: U yoshligidan beri balet bilan shug'ullanadi.

definition_en: A person who writes news stories for newspapers, magazines, or television.
example_en: The journalist interviewed the president about the new national policy.
example_uz: Jurnalist prezidentdan yangi milliy siyosat haqida intervyu oldi.

definition_en: Exceptionally large, productive, or successful in amount.
example_en: Farmers are expecting a bumper harvest of wheat this year.
example_uz: Dehqonlar bu yil bug'doydan mo'l-ko'l hosil olishni kutmoqdalar.

definition_en: At a later time after an event has already happened.
example_en: We had dinner at the cafe and went to the cinema afterwards.
example_uz: Biz kafeda ovqatlandik va keyin kinoga bordik.

definition_en: A single document on the internet that you can see in a web browser.
example_en: You can find all the information on the company's official webpage.
example_uz: Barcha ma'lumotlarni kompaniyaning rasmiy veb-sahifasidan topishingiz mumkin.

definition_en: A vegetable with a strong taste and smell used for flavoring food.
example_en: Many delicious recipes require you to add chopped garlic at the start.
example_uz: Ko'plab mazali retseptlar boshida maydalangan sarimsoq qo'shishni talab qiladi.

definition_en: To send out light or reflect light brightly.
example_en: The sun started to shine brightly after the heavy rain stopped.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg'ir to'xtagach, quyosh yorqin porlay boshladi.

definition_en: A loud noise and sudden release of energy caused by something blowing up.
example_en: The loud explosion caused significant damage to the surrounding old buildings.
example_uz: Kuchsli portlash atrofidagi eski binolarga jiddiy zarar yetkazdi.

definition_en: Not allowed by law or an official rule.
example_en: Smoking is banned in all public areas within the shopping mall.
example_uz: Savdo markazining barcha jamoat joylarida chekish taqiqlangan.

definition_en: A small area of sea along a coast that is sheltered by high rocks.
example_en: We found a quiet cove where the water was very calm.
example_uz: Biz suvi juda tinch bo'lgan sokin bir qo'ltiqchani topdik.

definition_en: A person who competes against or fights someone in a contest or sport.
example_en: My opponent in the chess match was much better than me.
example_uz: Shaxmat o'yinidagi raqibim mendan ancha kuchliroq edi.

definition_en: A food made from flour and water that is cooked in boiling water.
example_en: I usually make pasta with fresh tomato sauce for my dinner.
example_uz: Men kechki ovqatga odatda yangi pomidorli qayla bilan makaron pishiraman.

definition_en: Made easier to understand or simpler in appearance by removing extra parts.
example_en: The teacher gave us a simplified version of the difficult report.
example_uz: O'qituvchi bizga qiyin hisobotning soddalashtirilgan variantini berdi.

definition_en: A clear, watery liquid that is part of blood, often used to help the immune system.
example_en: The doctor administered a special serum to help boost the patient's immunity.
example_uz: Shifokor bemorning immunitetini oshirish uchun maxsus zardob yubordi.

definition_en: Covered in paper, cloth, or some other material for protection or as a gift.
example_en: I received a beautifully wrapped present for my birthday last week.
example_uz: Tug'ilgan kunimga chiroyli o'ralgan sovg'a oldim.

definition_en: Happening or done quickly and without any delay.
example_en: The government took swift action to stop the spread of the disease.
example_uz: Hukumat kasallik tarqalishini to'xtatish uchun tezkor choralar ko'rdi.

definition_en: The main circuit board inside a computer that connects all its electronic parts.
example_en: If the motherboard fails, the entire computer will stop working immediately.
example_uz: Agar ona plata ishdan chiqsa, butun kompyuter darhol to'xtab qoladi.

definition_en: The period of time during which a computer program or process is actually running.
example_en: The program has a long runtime because it handles a massive dataset.
example_uz: Dastur katta hajmdagi ma'lumotlar bilan ishlagani uchun uning ishlash vaqti uzoq.

definition_en: A folder on a computer or email account where received messages are stored.
example_en: I check my email inbox every morning before starting my daily tasks.
example_uz: Men har kuni ertalab kundalik ishlarimni boshlashdan oldin elektron pochtamni tekshiraman.

definition_en: Relating to the center or the most important part of something.
example_en: The focal point of the room was the large antique fireplace.
example_uz: Xonaning markaziy qismi katta antik kamin edi.

definition_en: Related to a list of books and articles used as sources for a document.
example_en: You must include all bibliographic information at the end of your research paper.
example_uz: Siz tadqiqot ishingiz oxirida barcha bibliografik ma'lumotlarni kiritishingiz shart.

definition_en: A place that is beautiful, peaceful, and represents perfect happiness.
example_en: They created a little garden of eden in their quiet backyard.
example_uz: Ular hovlisida kichkinagina jannatmonand bog' yaratishdi.

definition_en: Located far away in space or time.
example_en: We heard a distant sound of music coming from the village.
example_uz: Qishloqdan kelayotgan musiqaning uzoqdan eshitilayotgan tovushini eshitdik.

definition_en: A fancy white wine that has bubbles in it.
example_en: They opened a bottle of champagne to celebrate the new job.
example_uz: Yangi ishni nishonlash uchun shampan vinosi ochishdi.

definition_en: Based on the number ten.
example_en: The math teacher explained how to convert fractions into decimal numbers.
example_uz: Matematika o'qituvchisi oddiy kasrlarni o'nli kasrlarga aylantirishni tushuntirdi.

definition_en: The action of doing something different from what is normal or expected.
example_en: Any deviation from the standard rules will not be accepted today.
example_uz: Bugun standart qoidalardan har qanday chetlanish qabul qilinmaydi.

definition_en: A person who is in charge of a building or a specific department.
example_en: The building superintendent fixed the broken pipe in the basement quickly.
example_uz: Uy boshqaruvchisi yerto'ladagi yorilgan quvurni tezda tuzatib qo'ydi.

definition_en: A cheap place for travelers to sleep where they share a room with others.
example_en: We stayed in a budget hostel during our trip across Europe.
example_uz: Yevropa bo'ylab sayohatimizda arzon yotoqxonada turdik.

definition_en: To pay someone to work for you as your employee.
example_en: The local factory continues to employ many people in our town.
example_uz: Mahalliy zavod shahrimizdagi ko'plab odamlarni ish bilan ta'minlaydi.

definition_en: A black and white sea bird from cold areas that cannot fly but swims well.
example_en: We watched the penguins swimming and playing in the icy cold water.
example_uz: Biz muzdek suvda suzib yurgan va oʻynayotgan pingvinlarni tomosha qildik.

definition_en: Very beautiful or special in a way that feels like a dream.
example_en: The fireworks created a magical atmosphere on that beautiful summer night.
example_uz: Mushakbozlik oʻsha goʻzal yoz kechasida sehrli muhit yaratdi.

definition_en: The system of bringing water to land to help crops and plants grow.
example_en: Modern irrigation systems help farmers grow crops in very dry areas.
example_uz: Zamonaviy sugʻorish tizimlari dehqonlarga qurgʻoqchil hududlarda ham hosil yetishtirishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: A surprising and very good event that cannot be explained by natural laws.
example_en: It was a medical miracle that he survived the terrible car accident.
example_uz: Uning dahshatli avtohalokatdan omon qolishi tibbiy moʻjiza edi.

definition_en: Done by using hands instead of using a machine or a computer.
example_en: The student manually checked the numbers because the computer software had failed.
example_uz: Kompyuter dasturi ishlamay qolgani uchun talaba raqamlarni qoʻlda tekshirib chiqdi.

definition_en: A book or document that is published again after being printed before.
example_en: The reprint of this classic novel is cheaper than the original version.
example_uz: Bu klassik asarning qayta nashri dastlabki nusxasidan arzonroq turadi.

definition_en: Operated or moved by the pressure of liquid, usually water or oil.
example_en: The mechanic used a hydraulic jack to lift the heavy car easily.
example_uz: Mexanik ogʻir mashinani oson koʻtarish uchun gidravlik domkratdan foydalandi.

definition_en: To bend a part of your body, usually a joint or a muscle.
example_en: You should flex your muscles before you start the heavy workout.
example_uz: Og'ir mashqni boshlashdan oldin mushaklaringizni qizdirib olishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Happening or appearing once every single year.
example_en: Our yearly family trip to the mountains is always very fun.
example_uz: Oilamizning tog'larga qiladigan yillik sayohati doimo juda qiziqarli o'tadi.

definition_en: The act of moving into or through something that is hard to enter.
example_en: The deep penetration of the water caused the wood to rot slowly.
example_uz: Suvning ichkariga chuqur kirib borishi yog'ochning asta-sekin chirishiga sabab bo'ldi.

definition_en: A physical injury where the skin is cut or torn.
example_en: The nurse cleaned the deep wound on his leg very carefully.
example_uz: Hamshira uning oyog'idagi chuqur jarohatni juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan tozaladi.

definition_en: A woman who is considered the most beautiful or attractive at an event.
example_en: Wearing a stunning red dress, she was truly the belle of the ball.
example_uz: O'zining ajoyib qizil libosida u haqiqatan ham bazmning eng go'zal qizi edi.

definition_en: A strong belief or opinion that someone holds firmly.
example_en: He spoke about his political plans with great conviction and courage.
example_uz: U o'zining siyosiy rejalari haqida katta ishonch va jasorat bilan gapirdi.

definition_en: The symbol # used on computer keyboards or to indicate a number.
example_en: Please type a hash before the number to start the search.
example_uz: Qidiruvni boshlash uchun raqamdan oldin panjara belgisini yozing.

definition_en: Things that have not been included or done, intentionally or accidentally.
example_en: There were several serious omissions in the final report of the project.
example_uz: Loyiha bo‘yicha yakuniy hisobotda bir nechta jiddiy kamchiliklar bor edi.

definition_en: The books, articles, or documents that someone has written.
example_en: His philosophical writings have influenced many thinkers of the modern era.
example_uz: Uning falsafiy asarlari zamonaviy davrning ko‘plab mutafakkirlariga ta’sir ko‘rsatdi.

definition_en: The process of finding and getting back information that was saved.
example_en: Modern software allows for the fast retrieval of lost digital data.
example_uz: Zamonaviy dasturiy ta’minot yo‘qolgan raqamli ma’lumotlarni tezda qayta tiklash imkonini beradi.

definition_en: The good or bad characteristics or features that someone or something has.
example_en: She possesses all the qualities required for this high-level position.
example_uz: U ushbu yuqori lavozim uchun kerakli barcha fazilatlarga ega.

definition_en: A type of food substance that provides the body with energy.
example_en: I am eating fewer carbs to try and lose some weight.
example_uz: Vazn tashlash uchun uglevodlarni kamroq isteʼmol qilyapman.

definition_en: To show great surprise or admiration at something.
example_en: We stood there and continued to marvel at the beautiful sunset.
example_uz: Biz u yerda turib, goʻzal quyosh botishidan hayratda qoldik.

definition_en: Used to introduce a point that is very significant to the topic.
example_en: More importantly, we must ensure the project is finished on time.
example_uz: Eng muhimi, loyihani oʻz vaqtida yakunlashimiz kerak.

definition_en: Used to describe a woman who is short and slim.
example_en: She is quite petite and finds it hard to find clothes.
example_uz: U juda ixcham qomatli boʻlgani uchun oʻziga mos kiyim topishi qiyin.

definition_en: A very strong desire or urge to have or do something.
example_en: She had a sudden yen to travel to the mountains alone.
example_uz: Unda to‘satdan tog‘larga yolg‘iz sayohat qilishga kuchli ishtiyoq uyg‘ondi.

definition_en: Casual or unverified talk or reports about other people's private lives.
example_en: I try to avoid listening to office gossip during my lunch break.
example_uz: Tushlik paytida idoradagi g‘iybatlarni eshitmaslikka harakat qilaman.

definition_en: The act of officially suggesting someone for a job, position, or award.
example_en: Her nomination for the award was a highlight of her career.
example_uz: Uning mukofotga nomzod qilib ko‘rsatilishi faoliyatidagi eng muhim voqea bo‘ldi.

definition_en: Capable of rotating or moving around a central point.
example_en: The machine uses a rotary motion to cut the metal pieces efficiently.
example_uz: Mashina metall bo‘laklarini samarali kesish uchun aylanma harakatdan foydalanadi.

definition_en: A small animal with a long, thin, soft body and no legs.
example_en: The bird pulled a long worm out of the wet ground.
example_uz: Qush nam tuproqdan uzun chuvalchangni sug‘urib oldi.

definition_en: The state of needing someone or something to survive or function.
example_en: The country is trying to reduce its dependence on imported fuel.
example_uz: Mamlakat import qilinadigan yoqilg‘iga bo‘lgan qaramlikni kamaytirishga harakat qilmoqda.

definition_en: Separate, distinct, or individual parts that are not connected to each other.
example_en: The research project is divided into three discrete phases of work.
example_uz: Tadqiqot loyihasi uchta alohida ish bosqichiga bo‘lingan.

definition_en: Someone who is just starting to learn or do something new.
example_en: I am a beginner at tennis so I need some lessons.
example_uz: Men tennisni endi boshlayapman shuning uchun menga saboqlar kerak.

definition_en: The removable or hinged cover that fits over the top of a container.
example_en: Put the lid back on the jar to keep the cookies fresh.
example_uz: Pechenyelar qurib qolmasligi uchun idishning qopqog‘ini yopib qo‘y.

definition_en: The condition of being male or female and the feelings related to sex.
example_en: The book explores the complexity of human sexuality in modern society.
example_uz: Kitob zamonaviy jamiyatdagi inson jinsiy xususiyatlarining murakkabligini o‘rganadi.

definition_en: A type of strong artificial cloth that is often used to make clothes.
example_en: This shirt is made of polyester and is easy to wash.
example_uz: Bu ko‘ylak poliesterdan tikilgan va yuvishga juda oson.

definition_en: Having the shape of a cube or relating to a volume of space.
example_en: The tank has a capacity of five hundred cubic meters.
example_uz: Bakning sig‘imi besh yuz kub metrga teng.

definition_en: Someone who is unable to hear anything or has very poor hearing.
example_en: There are special schools for deaf children to learn sign language.
example_uz: Kar bolalar imo-ishora tilini o‘rganishi uchun maxsus maktablar mavjud.

definition_en: A precious stone that is usually deep blue in color.
example_en: She wore a beautiful ring set with a bright blue sapphire.
example_uz: U yorqin ko‘k rangli safir o‘rnatilgan chiroyli uzuk taqib yurardi.

definition_en: A type of protein that helps change chemical substances inside living cells.
example_en: The researchers studied how the specific kinase affects cell growth in humans.
example_uz: Tadqiqotchilar ushbu kinaza inson hujayralari o‘sishiga qanday ta’sir qilishini o‘rganib chiqishdi.

definition_en: To focus your study or work on one particular subject or activity.
example_en: She is specializing in international law after finishing her university degree.
example_uz: U universitetni bitirgach xalqaro huquq bo‘yicha ixtisoslashmoqda.

definition_en: Raw materials or agricultural products that can be bought and sold in bulk.
example_en: The price of global commodities like oil and gold is rising again.
example_uz: Neft va oltin kabi jahon xomashyo tovarlari narxi yana ko‘tarilmoqda.

definition_en: An elected law enforcement officer who is responsible for a specific county.
example_en: The local sheriff arrived quickly to help the people at the accident.
example_uz: Voqea joyidagi odamlarga yordam berish uchun mahalliy sherif zudlik bilan yetib keldi.

definition_en: A make-believe creature with the body of a lion and wings of an eagle.
example_en: Ancient legends often describe the griffin as a guardian of hidden treasures.
example_uz: Qadimiy afsonalarda grifon ko‘pincha yashirin xazinalarning qo‘riqchisi sifatida tasvirlanadi.

definition_en: People who secretly collect information about other countries or organizations.
example_en: The movie tells a thrilling story about two spies meeting in secret.
example_uz: Film maxfiy ravishda uchrashayotgan ikki josus haqidagi hayajonli hikoyani so‘zlab beradi.

definition_en: Not interesting or exciting; dull.
example_en: The new restaurant is okay, but their menu is a little blah.
example_uz: Yangi restoran yomon emas, lekin taomnomasi sal zerikarliroq.

definition_en: A person who acts out a story using only body movements and gestures.
example_en: The mime performed a funny scene in the park without saying anything.
example_uz: Mim bog‘da hech narsa demasdan juda kulgili sahna ko‘rsatib berdi.

definition_en: A person who lives in a house or apartment near you.
example_en: Our neighbor kindly offered to water our plants while we were away.
example_uz: Biz yo‘qligimizda qo‘shnimiz o‘simliklarimizni sug‘orib turishni taklif qildi.

definition_en: To choose someone for a position by voting.
example_en: The citizens will elect a new leader in the upcoming national voting.
example_uz: Fuqarolar bo‘lajak saylovlarda yangi rahbar saylashadi.

definition_en: Having a very close and personal relationship with someone.
example_en: He and his sister have an intimate relationship and share everything.
example_uz: U singlisi bilan juda samimiy munosabatda va hamma sirlarini bo‘lishadi.

definition_en: Relating to the process of producing babies or new living things.
example_en: The clinic provides essential information regarding reproductive health for young adults.
example_uz: Klinika yoshlar uchun reproduktiv salomatlik bo‘yicha muhim ma’lumotlar beradi.

definition_en: Likely to cause death or very serious harm.
example_en: The snake has a deadly poison that can kill in minutes.
example_uz: Bu ilonning zaharli tishi bir necha daqiqada o'limga olib kelishi mumkin.

definition_en: A small animal with long ears, often used as a name for a rabbit.
example_en: My little daughter loves to play with her toy bunny.
example_uz: Kichkina qizim o'yinchoq quyonchasi bilan o'ynashni juda yaxshi ko'radi.

definition_en: A machine that keeps food cold so that it stays fresh.
example_en: Please put the fresh milk back into the refrigerator after use.
example_uz: Iltimos yangi sutni ishlatib bo'lgach, yana muzlatgichga solib qo'ying.

definition_en: People whose job is to clean and repair people's teeth.
example_en: Dentists recommend brushing your teeth at least twice every day.
example_uz: Stomatologlar tishni har kuni kamida ikki marta yuvishni tavsiya qilishadi.

definition_en: The act of not letting someone or something enter or join a group.
example_en: The social exclusion of certain groups remains a serious global problem.
example_uz: Ayrim guruhlarni jamiyatdan chetlatish jiddiy global muammo bo'lib qolmoqda.

definition_en: An area at a workplace assigned to a single person for their daily tasks.
example_en: Each employee has their own workstation with a computer and comfortable chair.
example_uz: Har bir xodimning kompyuter va qulay stul bilan jihozlangan o'z ish joyi bor.

definition_en: Very interested, enthusiastic, or eager to do something.
example_en: She is very keen on learning how to play the guitar.
example_uz: U gitara chalishni o'rganishga juda qiziqadi.

definition_en: The measured amount of medicine to be taken at a specific time.
example_en: The doctor explained the correct dosage for this new antibiotic medication.
example_uz: Shifokor ushbu yangi antibiotik uchun to'g'ri dozani tushuntirib berdi.

definition_en: The amount by which something is different from what was expected or planned.
example_en: There was a significant variance between the estimated and actual costs.
example_uz: Rejalashtirilgan va haqiqiy xarajatlar o‘rtasida sezilarli farq bor edi.

definition_en: A person or device that helps to find the right direction for travel.
example_en: The ship's navigator plotted the course across the rough ocean.
example_uz: Kema navigatori bo‘ronli okean bo‘ylab yo‘nalishni belgilab oldi.

definition_en: A country located in Central and Western Africa.
example_en: Cameroon is known for its diverse landscapes and many languages.
example_uz: Kamerun o‘zining rang-barang tabiati va ko‘plab tillari bilan mashhur.

definition_en: The process of cooking food such as bread or cakes in an oven.
example_en: I really enjoy baking cakes for my family on the weekends.
example_uz: Dam olish kunlari oilam uchun pishiriqlar pishirishni juda yaxshi ko‘raman.

definition_en: A type of drug made from the dried leaves and flowers of a plant.
example_en: The sale of marijuana is strictly regulated in many different countries.
example_uz: Ko‘pgina mamlakatlarda nashaning sotilishi qat’iy nazorat qilinadi.

definition_en: Able to change easily to suit new conditions or different situations.
example_en: Humans have highly adaptive skills that help them survive in new environments.
example_uz: Insonlar yangi sharoitlarda yashab ketishga yordam beradigan yuqori moslashuvchanlik qobiliyatiga ega.

definition_en: Determined or calculated by using mathematics or a computer.
example_en: The total distance was computed using a satellite navigation system.
example_uz: Umumiy masofa sun’iy yo‘ldosh navigatsiya tizimi yordamida hisoblab chiqildi.

definition_en: A small, thin metal tool with a sharp point used for sewing.
example_en: She used a needle and thread to fix the hole in her shirt.
example_uz: U ko‘ylagidagi teshikni igna va ip bilan tikib qo‘ydi.

definition_en: The largest and most important church in a specific area or city.
example_en: The old city is famous for its beautiful stone cathedral.
example_uz: Qadimiy shahar o‘zining go‘zal tosh katedrali bilan mashhur.

definition_en: To have something as your legal property.
example_en: He owns a small house in the center of the city.
example_uz: U shaharning markazida kichkina uyga ega.

definition_en: Made of or covered with a substance that sticks to other things.
example_en: My fingers were sticky after eating the sweet candy.
example_uz: Shirin konfetni yeganimdan keyin barmoqlarim yopishqoq bo‘lib qoldi.

definition_en: The events that will happen to a person in the future, often thought to be unchangeable.
example_en: It was his destiny to become a leader of the country one day.
example_uz: Kun kelib mamlakat rahbari bo'lish uning peshonasiga yozilgan edi.

definition_en: A state of having a serious mental illness or acting in a very stupid way.
example_en: It would be absolute madness to drive in such heavy snow storms.
example_uz: Bunday kuchli qor bo'ronida mashina haydash shunchaki telbalikdir.

definition_en: To use your hands and feet to go up or towards the top of something.
example_en: The children love to climb the old oak tree in the garden.
example_uz: Bolalar bog'dagi eski eman daraxtiga chiqishni yaxshi ko'rishadi.

definition_en: Extremely interesting and attractive, holding your attention completely.
example_en: The documentary about deep ocean creatures was absolutely fascinating to watch.
example_uz: Chuqur okean mavjudotlari haqidagi hujjatli filmni tomosha qilish juda qiziqarli edi.

definition_en: The act or process of calculating numbers or results using mathematics.
example_en: The computer performed the complex computation in less than a second.
example_uz: Kompyuter murakkab hisob-kitobni bir soniyadan kam vaqt ichida bajardi.

definition_en: Grass that has been cut and dried to be used as food for animals.
example_en: Farmers store piles of hay in the barn for the winter season.
example_uz: Fermerlar qish mavsumi uchun omborga pichan gʻamlashadi.

definition_en: Relating to the heart and the blood vessels that move blood around the body.
example_en: Regular exercise is very important for maintaining a healthy cardiovascular system.
example_uz: Muntazam mashqlar yurak-qon tomir tizimini sogʻlom saqlash uchun juda muhim.

definition_en: Relating to the heart or problems affecting the heart.
example_en: The patient was rushed to the hospital after a cardiac arrest.
example_uz: Bemor yurak tutilishi sodir boʻlgach, shoshilinch ravishda kasalxonaga olib ketildi.

definition_en: The act of saving someone from danger or a very difficult situation.
example_en: The new government policy was seen as the economic salvation of the country.
example_uz: Yangi hukumat siyosati mamlakat iqtisodiyoti uchun najot deb qaraldi.

definition_en: The tiny independent city-state in Rome that serves as the headquarters of the Catholic Church.
example_en: Thousands of people gathered in the Vatican to hear the Pope speak.
example_uz: Rim papasining nutqini tinglash uchun Vatikanga minglab odamlar to‘plandilar.

definition_en: Extremely cruel, violent, or showing no care for the feelings of others.
example_en: The brutal winter cold made it impossible to stay outside for long.
example_uz: Qishning shafqatsiz sovuqida tashqarida uzoq qolishning imkoni yo‘q edi.

definition_en: People who are gaining knowledge or skills in a particular subject or activity.
example_en: The teacher provided extra materials for the faster learners in class.
example_uz: O‘qituvchi sinfdagi tezroq o‘rganuvchi o‘quvchilar uchun qo‘shimcha materiallar berdi.

definition_en: Being very careful and choosy when deciding which people or things to pick.
example_en: She is very selective about the friends she spends her time with.
example_uz: U vaqtini birga o‘tkazadigan do‘stlarini tanlashda juda sinchkov.

definition_en: A formal process to settle a disagreement by using an independent person or judge.
example_en: The two companies decided to use arbitration to resolve their contract dispute.
example_uz: Ikki kompaniya shartnoma bo‘yicha nizoni hal qilish uchun hakamlikka murojaat etishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Something that acts as a symbol or a sign of a feeling or event.
example_en: Please accept these flowers as a token of my sincere gratitude.
example_uz: Iltimos, bu gullarni chuqur minnatdorchiligimning nishonasi sifatida qabul qiling.

definition_en: A hard, bluish-white metal element used to cover other metals to prevent rust.
example_en: The metal roof was coated in zinc to stop it from corroding.
example_uz: Zanglashning oldini olish uchun metall tom rux bilan qoplandi.

definition_en: To give up something valuable that you want in order to help someone else.
example_en: Parents often sacrifice their own needs to provide a better future for children.
example_uz: Ota-onalar ko‘pincha farzandlarining kelajagi uchun o‘z ehtiyojlarini qurbon qiladilar.

definition_en: An expert or a respected teacher who gives advice in a specific field.
example_en: He is considered a marketing guru by many successful business owners worldwide.
example_uz: U dunyodagi ko‘plab muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkorlar tomonidan marketing ustasi deb tan olingan.

definition_en: Able to be taken away or detached from something else easily.
example_en: The laptop has a removable battery that you can replace quite easily.
example_uz: Noutbukning osongina almashtirsa bo‘ladigan yechiluvchi batareyasi bor.

definition_en: The process of moving together or meeting at a single point.
example_en: The convergence of these two technologies has changed how we use smartphones.
example_uz: Ushbu ikki texnologiyaning yaqinlashuvi smartfonlardan foydalanish usulimizni butunlay o‘zgartirdi.

definition_en: To officially demand and collect a payment, such as a tax or fine.
example_en: The government decided to levy a new tax on imported electronic goods.
example_uz: Hukumat import qilinadigan elektron tovarlarga yangi soliq solishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Related to or expressed by numbers or digits.
example_en: Please ensure that the password contains at least one numeric character inside.
example_uz: Iltimos, parol ichida kamida bitta raqam borligiga ishonch hosil qiling.

definition_en: The scientific study of human societies, cultures, and their development over time.
example_en: She decided to study anthropology to better understand diverse human cultural practices.
example_uz: U turli xalqlar madaniyatini yaxshiroq tushunish uchun antropologiyani o‘rganishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: The sport or activity of moving across ice or smooth surfaces on skates.
example_en: We went ice skating at the local park during the winter weekend.
example_uz: Qishgi dam olish kunlari mahalliy bog'da konkida uchgani bordik.

definition_en: To a small or moderate degree; rather or somewhat.
example_en: It is getting kinda cold outside, so you should wear a coat.
example_uz: Tashqarida biroz sovib qoldi, shuning uchun palto kiyib olishing kerak.

definition_en: A man who rules over a group of countries or an empire.
example_en: The ancient emperor lived in a large palace with his royal family.
example_uz: Qadimiy imperator o'z qirollik oilasi bilan katta saroyda yashagan.

definition_en: A person who has successfully completed a course of study at a university.
example_en: Every recent grad is looking for a good job in the city.
example_uz: Har bir yangi bitiruvchi shahardan yaxshi ish qidirmoqda.

definition_en: Careless, illegal, or unethical conduct by a professional person like a doctor.
example_en: The hospital faced a lawsuit due to serious medical malpractice.
example_uz: Kasalxona jiddiy tibbiy xato tufayli sudga tortildi.

definition_en: In a way that shows you are pleased with your own or someone else's achievements.
example_en: The student proudly presented her project in front of the whole class.
example_uz: O‘quvchi qiz o‘z loyihasini butun sinf oldida faxr bilan taqdim etdi.

definition_en: Something that is needed or essential for a particular purpose.
example_en: Clean water is a basic necessity for every person on this planet.
example_uz: Toza suv sayyoramizdagi har bir inson uchun asosiy zaruratdir.

definition_en: A drawing or artistic representation of an object or a building.
example_en: The architect showed us a detailed digital rendering of the new house.
example_uz: Me’mor bizga yangi uyning batafsil raqamli tasvirini ko‘rsatdi.

definition_en: The name of a file without any information about its folder location.
example_en: You need to change the basename of the file before uploading it.
example_uz: Faylni yuklashdan oldin uning asosiy nomini o‘zgartirishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A narrow channel of water between two pieces of land, often in Scotland.
example_en: The boat sailed slowly through the calm waters of the mountain kyle.
example_uz: Qayiq tog‘lar orasidagi sokin bo‘g‘oz bo‘ylab sekin suzib o‘tdi.

definition_en: Relating to the residential areas on the outer edge of a large city.
example_en: They moved to a quiet suburban neighborhood to raise their young children.
example_uz: Ular yosh bolalarini tarbiyalash uchun shahar chetidagi sokin mahallaga ko‘chib o‘tishdi.

definition_en: The highest point or the top part of something.
example_en: The mountain’s vertex was covered in thick snow all year round.
example_uz: Tog'ning choqqisi yil davomida qalin qor bilan qoplangan edi.

definition_en: A serious medical condition where the liver becomes swollen and damaged.
example_en: He had to be careful with his diet after getting hepatitis.
example_uz: Gepatit bilan og'rib chiqqanidan keyin u parheziga e'tiborli bo'lishi kerak edi.

definition_en: Relating to or affecting the whole country.
example_en: The president’s important speech was broadcast nationally yesterday evening.
example_uz: Prezidentning muhim nutqi kecha kechqurun butun mamlakat bo'ylab efirga uzatildi.

definition_en: A soft red fruit that is eaten as a vegetable in salads.
example_en: He was chopping a fresh tomato to put in the salad.
example_uz: U salatga qo'shish uchun yangi pomidorni to'g'rayotgan edi.

definition_en: Designed to keep water out so that it does not get inside.
example_en: Make sure you wear a waterproof jacket if you go outside today.
example_uz: Bugun tashqariga chiqsangiz, albatta suv o'tkazmaydigan kurtka kiyib oling.

definition_en: Perfectly level or even with another surface.
example_en: Sand the wood until it is flush with the metal frame.
example_uz: Yog'ochni metall ramka bilan barobar bo'lguncha silliqlang.

definition_en: A formal document that gives up a legal right or requirement.
example_en: I had to sign a waiver before starting the dangerous parachute jump.
example_uz: Parashyutdan sakrashdan oldin javobgarlikdan voz kechish haqidagi hujjatni imzoladim.

definition_en: Having skin color that is lighter than usual because of sickness or fear.
example_en: His face turned pale after hearing the very sad news today.
example_uz: Bu juda qayg'uli xabarni eshitgach yuzi oqarib ketdi.

definition_en: Subjects or areas that someone knows a lot about or focuses on.
example_en: The university offers many different medical specialties for its students.
example_uz: Universitet talabalar uchun ko'plab tibbiy yo'nalishlarni taklif qiladi.

definition_en: A feeling of great happiness and enjoyment.
example_en: It was a pure delight to see the children playing outside.
example_uz: Bolalarning tashqarida o'ynayotganini ko'rish juda katta zavq bag'ishladi.

definition_en: A person who remains alive after a dangerous event like an accident or war.
example_en: She was a survivor of the earthquake that destroyed her entire village.
example_uz: U butun qishlog'ini vayron qilgan zilziladan omon qolganlardan biri edi.

definition_en: The systems by which a country produces and uses its wealth and resources.
example_en: Stronger economies often have more influence in international trade deals.
example_uz: Kuchliroq iqtisodiyotlar xalqaro savdo kelishuvlarida ko'proq ta'sirga ega.

definition_en: Relating to or caused by tiny living organisms that can cause disease.
example_en: The doctor gave me some medicine to treat my bacterial throat infection.
example_uz: Shifokor tomoq yallig'lanishini davolash uchun menga dori-darmon yozib berdi.

definition_en: Happening all the time without any pause or stop.
example_en: The rain fell continuously for three days, causing the river to rise.
example_uz: Yomg'ir uch kun davomida tinmay yog'ib, daryo suvining toshishiga sabab bo'ldi.

definition_en: To pull something apart or into pieces with force.
example_en: Be careful not to tear the thin paper when you open it.
example_uz: Qog'ozni ochayotganda uni yirtib yubormaslikka harakat qil.

definition_en: A valuable stone that is often used in jewelry.
example_en: She wore a necklace decorated with a small blue jewel.
example_uz: U bo'yniga mayda ko'k javohir bilan bezatilgan marjon taqib olgan edi.

definition_en: A soft toy bear that children often hold when they sleep.
example_en: My little daughter never goes to sleep without her favorite teddy.
example_uz: Qizalog'im sevimli o'yinchoq ayiqchasisiz uxlay olmaydi.

definition_en: A car that has a roof that can be folded down or removed.
example_en: We drove along the coast in a convertible with the roof down.
example_uz: Biz dengiz bo'yi bo'ylab tomi ochiq avtomobilda sayr qildik.

definition_en: A person you do not know.
example_en: Children are taught never to talk to a stranger in the street.
example_uz: Bolalarga ko‘chada notanish odamlar bilan gaplashmaslik o‘rgatiladi.

definition_en: A very sad or bad event that causes great suffering.
example_en: The sudden loss of life in the accident was a terrible tragedy.
example_uz: Baxtsiz hodisadagi to‘satdan odamlar o‘limi dahshatli fojia edi.

definition_en: A structure built by a bird to hold its eggs and young.
example_en: The mother bird is sitting on eggs in her nest.
example_uz: Ona qush uyasida tuxum bosib o‘tiribdi.

definition_en: A machine that removes water from clothes using hot air.
example_en: I put my wet clothes in the dryer to get them ready.
example_uz: Nam kiyimlarimni quritish uchun quritgichga soldim.

definition_en: Causing physical pain or making you feel very sad and unhappy.
example_en: It was a painful experience to lose my best friend last year.
example_uz: O'tgan yili eng yaqin do'stimdan ayrilish juda og'riqli bo'ldi.

definition_en: A soft, thick fabric with short threads, often used for expensive clothing.
example_en: She wore a beautiful dress made of dark blue velvet to dinner.
example_uz: U kechki ovqatga to'q ko'k rangli baxmaldan tikilgan chiroyli ko'ylak kiyib bordi.

definition_en: A special court of law that judges cases, especially one not part of the normal system.
example_en: The international tribunal was set up to investigate crimes against humanity.
example_uz: Xalqaro tribunal insoniyatga qarshi jinoyatlarni tekshirish uchun tashkil etildi.

definition_en: Very stylish and unusual, or modern and exciting in a different way.
example_en: Those funky shoes you are wearing today look really cool and original.
example_uz: Bugun kiyib olgan o'sha o'zgacha tufli juda zo'r va kreativ ko'rinyapti.

definition_en: An office or group of people responsible for administrative work in an organization.
example_en: The secretariat handles all the correspondence and scheduling for the main board.
example_uz: Kotibiyat boshqaruv kengashi uchun barcha yozishmalar va rejalashtirish ishlarini bajaradi.

definition_en: Not in any place or to any place.
example_en: We searched for the missing documents, but they were nowhere to be found.
example_uz: Biz yo'qolgan hujjatlarni qidirdik, lekin ularni hech qayerdan topa olmadik.

definition_en: An informal word for a police officer.
example_en: The cop pulled the speeding driver over to the side of the road.
example_uz: Politsiyachi tezlikni oshirgan haydovchini yo'l chetiga to'xtatdi.

definition_en: A very strong wind, much stronger than a breeze.
example_en: Many parts of the boat were damaged in the gale.
example_uz: Qayiqning ko'p qismlari kuchli shamol tufayli shikastlandi.

definition_en: Not bright or having very little light.
example_en: The lighting was too dim for me to see clearly.
example_uz: Yoritish juda xira bo'lgani uchun aniq ko'ra olmadim.

definition_en: Happening recently or in the short time before now.
example_en: It is only lately that I have been feeling better.
example_uz: Faqat oxirgi paytlarda o'zimni yaxshiroq his qilyapman.

definition_en: No longer planned or scheduled to happen.
example_en: The game was cancelled because of heavy rain.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg'ir sababli o'yin bekor qilindi.

definition_en: Making you feel afraid or nervous.
example_en: She was hiding during the scary parts of the film.
example_uz: U filmning qo'rqinchli joylarida yashirinib o'tirdi.

definition_en: A large soft pad that you sleep on, usually on a bed.
example_en: I need to buy a new mattress for my bed.
example_uz: Karavotim uchun yangi matras sotib olishim kerak.

definition_en: Used to say that someone feels the same way or does the same thing.
example_en: It was a pleasure meeting you today. ― Likewise, it was my pleasure.
example_uz: Siz bilan tanishganimdan juda xursandman. ― Men ham, o'zaro.

definition_en: Coming at the beginning to explain what will follow or to teach basic information.
example_en: She decided to register for an introductory course in computer science.
example_uz: U kompyuter savodxonligi bo'yicha kirish kursiga yozilishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Something that happens, especially something unexpected or important.
example_en: Heavy storms are a common occurrence in this part of the world.
example_uz: Kuchli bo'ronlar dunyoning bu qismida tez-tez uchrab turadigan hodisadir.

definition_en: A famous person who is greatly admired and loved by many fans.
example_en: The young singer became an idol for millions of teenagers around the world.
example_uz: Yosh qo'shiqchi dunyo bo'ylab millionlab o'smirlarning kumiriga aylandi.

definition_en: A kitchen machine used for mixing, beating, or blending food ingredients together.
example_en: I used the electric mixer to blend the ingredients for the cake.
example_uz: Tort uchun masalliqlarni aralashtirishda elektr mikserdan foydalandim.

definition_en: Relating to the punishment or enforcement of rules within an organization.
example_en: The school has taken disciplinary measures against the students who were fighting.
example_uz: Maktab mushtlashgan o‘quvchilarga nisbatan intizomiy choralar ko‘rdi.

definition_en: Making you feel slightly angry or impatient.
example_en: Having flies in your bedroom when you are trying to sleep is annoying.
example_uz: Uxlamoqchi bo‘lganingizda yotoqxonada pashsha bo‘lishi juda asabga tegadi.

definition_en: To provide information that was previously kept secret.
example_en: The company did not disclose the total cost of the new project.
example_uz: Kompaniya yangi loyihaning umumiy qiymatini oshkor qilmadi.

definition_en: An event, situation, or matter that you are talking about.

example_uz: Butun tadbirni boshqarish kichik jamoamiz uchun qiyin ish bo‘ldi.

definition_en: Past tense of drive, meaning to operate a vehicle.

example_uz: U bugun erta tongda mashinasini shahar markaziga haydadi.

definition_en: A small flat ring placed under a nut to make a joint tighter.

example_uz: Oshxonadagi oqayotgan quvurni tuzatish uchun menga metall shayba kerak.

definition_en: Feeling unhappy, worried, or angry because something bad has happened.
example_en: He was quite upset when his friends did not come to visit.
example_uz: Do'stlari kelmaganida u juda xafa bo'ldi.

definition_en: At the side of something or someone.
example_en: She sat beside her mother and started to talk about her day.
example_uz: U onasining yoniga o'tirib, kun bo'yi nimalar qilganini gapirib berdi.

definition_en: To bounce back after hitting a surface or to recover from a difficult situation.

example_uz: Umid qilamanki, o'tgan yilgi qiyinchiliklardan so'ng iqtisodiyot yana tiklanadi.

definition_en: Past tense of fight; to use violence or argue to achieve something.
example_en: They fought bravely for their country during the long and difficult war.
example_uz: Ular uzoq va qiyin urush davrida o'z vatanlari uchun jasorat bilan kurashdilar.

definition_en: The process of removing someone or something from a competition or process.
example_en: The team faced immediate elimination after losing the final match today.
example_uz: Jamoa final o‘yinida mag‘lub bo‘lgach, musobaqadan chiqib ketdi.

definition_en: The plural form of a unit for measuring distance or length.
example_en: The garden is twenty metres long and ten metres wide.
example_uz: Bog‘ning uzunligi yigirma metr, eni esa o‘n metrga teng.

definition_en: Based on a situation that is not real but might happen or exist.
example_en: It is just a hypothetical scenario, so do not worry too much.
example_uz: Bu shunchaki faraziy holat, shuning uchun ortiqcha xavotirlanmang.

definition_en: People who come to live permanently in a foreign country.

definition_en: Given for free as a gift or a special service.
example_en: The hotel offers complimentary breakfast to all of its guests daily.
example_uz: Mehmonxona har kuni barcha mehmonlariga bepul nonushta taqdim etadi.

definition_en: A type of aircraft that flies using large spinning blades on its top.
example_en: We flew over the city in a small police helicopter.
example_uz: Biz shahar uzra kichik politsiya vertolyotida uchdik.

definition_en: To turn into ice or become very hard because of cold temperatures.
example_en: If you leave water outside in winter, it will soon freeze.
example_uz: Agar suvni qishda tashqarida qoldirsangiz, u tez orada muzlaydi.

definition_en: A person who entertains an audience by acting, singing, or dancing.
example_en: The talented performer received a loud round of applause from everyone.
example_uz: Iqtidorli ijrochi barchaning olqishiga sazovor bo‘ldi.

definition_en: A very small green plant that grows on damp surfaces like stones or trees.
example_en: Thick green moss was growing on the side of the old tree.
example_uz: Qadimiy daraxtning yon tomonida qalin yashil mox o‘sib yotgan edi.

definition_en: A state of agreement and peaceful harmony between people or groups.
example_en: The two countries lived in concord for many decades after the war.
example_uz: Urushdan keyin ikki mamlakat o‘nlab yillar davomida totuvlikda yashadi.

definition_en: A hard-shelled nut with a wrinkled interior that grows on a large tree.
example_en: I added some chopped walnut pieces to my healthy morning porridge.
example_uz: Men sog‘lom ertalabki bo‘tqamga maydalangan yong‘oq bo‘lakchalarini qo‘shdim.

definition_en: To cut open an infected swelling on the body to let the fluid out.
example_en: The doctor had to lance the painful boil on his arm yesterday.
example_uz: Shifokor kecha uning qo‘lidagi og‘riqli husnbuzarni yorib tozalashi kerak edi.

definition_en: A tool with steps used for climbing up to reach high places.
example_en: He climbed up the ladder to fix the light on the ceiling.
example_uz: U shipdagi chiroqni tuzatish uchun narvonga chiqdi.

definition_en: Something that you do not need because it is not required.
example_en: It is unnecessary to bring an umbrella since the sun is shining.
example_uz: Quyosh charaqlab turganda soyabon olishning keragi yo'q.

definition_en: Very suddenly and to a very great or noticeable degree.
example_en: The number of students in the library has increased dramatically this year.
example_uz: Bu yil kutubxonadagi talabalar soni keskin oshdi.

definition_en: A small object used to close the top of a bottle.
example_en: He pulled the cork out of the bottle to pour the wine.
example_uz: U sharob quyish uchun shisha tapasini tortib oldi.

definition_en: A period of time when you do physical exercise to get fit.
example_en: I usually do a tough workout at the gym every morning.
example_uz: Men odatda har kuni ertalab sport zalida qiyin mashq bajaraman.

definition_en: The flow or loss of blood from a body after being injured.
example_en: Internal bleeding is often difficult to detect and requires immediate medical attention.
example_uz: Ichki qon ketishni aniqlash qiyin va u zudlik bilan tibbiy yordamni talab qiladi.

definition_en: The way in which a person or thing is described or represented.
example_en: The author provides a brilliant characterization of the main protagonist in chapter one.
example_uz: Muallif birinchi bobdayoq bosh qahramonning yorqin tavsifini beradi.

definition_en: The punctuation mark used before a list or an explanation.
example_en: You should use a colon to introduce a list of items here.
example_uz: Bu yerda narsalar ro'yxatini kiritish uchun ikki nuqtadan foydalanishingiz kerak.

definition_en: The process of making something dirty or poisonous by adding harmful substances.
example_en: The water supply faced contamination from local industrial waste products.
example_uz: Suv ta'minoti mahalliy sanoat chiqindilari sababli ifloslanish xavfiga duch keldi.

definition_en: An agreement where both sides give up something to reach a solution.
example_en: They finally reached a compromise that satisfied both parties in the dispute.
example_uz: Ular nihoyat nizodagi har ikki tomonni ham qanoatlantiradigan kelishuvga erishdilar.

definition_en: To make something as effective or useful as it can possibly be.
example_en: The company wants to optimize its workflow to increase overall productivity.
example_uz: Kompaniya umumiy unumdorlikni oshirish uchun o'z ish jarayonini optimallashtirmoqchi.

definition_en: A rounded roof or ceiling that looks like the top half of a ball.
example_en: The ancient cathedral is famous for its massive gold-covered stone dome.
example_uz: Qadimiy sobor o'zining ulkan tilla qoplamali tosh gumbazi bilan mashhur.

definition_en: The date or time when something is no longer valid or useful.
example_en: Please check the expiration date on the milk carton before drinking it.
example_uz: Ichishdan oldin sut qutisidagi yaroqlilik muddatini tekshirib ko'ring.

definition_en: A logical area in computer code used to organize names and avoid naming conflicts.
example_en: You should place your new functions inside the global namespace to prevent errors.
example_uz: Xatolarni oldini olish uchun yangi funksiyalaringizni global nomlar fazosiga joylashtirishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Not relating to the main or most important part of something.
example_en: The committee focused on core issues rather than peripheral concerns about minor details.
example_uz: Qo'mita kichik tafsilotlar kabi ikkilamchi masalalarga emas, balki asosiy muammolarga diqqat qaratdi.

definition_en: To ask for God's protection or favor for someone or something.
example_en: The elderly man would always bless his grandchildren before they traveled away.
example_uz: Keksaygan bobo nabiralari yo'lga chiqishidan oldin ularga doim oq fotiha berardi.

definition_en: Formal discussions between people who are trying to reach an agreement.
example_en: Both sides agreed to return to the table for further negotiation today.
example_uz: Ikki tomon bugun yana muzokaralar stoliga qaytishga kelishib olishdi.

definition_en: The highest part of a hill, mountain, or a wave.
example_en: They finally reached the crest of the hill after a long climb.
example_uz: Uzoq koʻtarilishdan soʻng nihoyat tepalikning choqqisiga yetib kelishdi.

definition_en: A great victory or achievement after a difficult struggle.
example_en: Winning the championship was a true triumph for the young team.
example_uz: Chempionlikni qoʻlga kiritish yosh jamoa uchun chinakam zafar boʻldi.

definition_en: The state of keeping information private and secret from others.
example_en: The doctor is required to maintain the confidentiality of patient records.
example_uz: Shifokor bemorlarning tibbiy maʼlumotlari maxfiyligini saqlashi shart.

definition_en: Relating to the process of choosing people by voting.
example_en: The government is planning to change the current electoral system soon.
example_uz: Hukumat yaqin orada amaldagi saylov tizimini oʻzgartirishni rejalashtirmoqda.

definition_en: A document listing all the changes made to a software project.
example_en: You can check the changelog to see what was updated today.
example_uz: Bugun nimalar yangilangani bilan tanishish uchun oʻzgarishlar jurnalini koʻring.

definition_en: The process of joining two pieces of metal by heating them.
example_en: He learned the art of welding to repair the farm equipment.
example_uz: U fermadagi texnikalarni tuzatish uchun payvandlash sanʼatini oʻrgandi.

definition_en: Happening at a later time than originally planned.
example_en: The company offered a deferred payment plan for all its customers.
example_uz: Kompaniya barcha mijozlariga toʻlovni kechiktirish rejasini taklif qildi.

definition_en: Used to suggest another option or possibility.
example_en: You can take the bus; alternatively, we can walk there together.
example_uz: Avtobusda ketishingiz mumkin, yoki boʻlmasa piyoda birga boramiz.

definition_en: The back part of the human foot below the ankle.
example_en: I have a painful blister on my left heel from walking.
example_uz: Ko‘p yurganimdan chap tovonimda qadoq paydo bo‘lib qoldi.

definition_en: A metal made by mixing two or more different types of metal together.
example_en: Steel is a strong alloy made from iron and carbon.
example_uz: Po‘lat bu temir va ugleroddan yasalgan mustahkam qotishma.

definition_en: Doing something in a kind, quiet, or careful way.
example_en: She gently picked up the baby so he would not wake.
example_uz: U go‘dakni uyg‘onib ketmasin deb juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko‘tardi.

definition_en: A large metal box that uses electricity to keep food and drinks cold.
example_en: Please put the milk back in the fridge after you use it.
example_uz: Sutni ishlatib bo‘lgach, iltimos, yana muzlatgichga qo‘yib qo‘y.

definition_en: The time when a flower is fully open and healthy.
example_en: The cherry trees in the garden are in full bloom now.
example_uz: Bog‘dagi olcha daraxtlari ayni paytda to‘liq gullab yotibdi.

definition_en: A severe physical injury or a deeply distressing emotional experience.
example_en: She had to undergo therapy to overcome the trauma of the accident.
example_uz: U baxtsiz hodisadan keyingi ruhiy jarohatni yengish uchun davolanishi kerak edi.

definition_en: A public notice or announcement promoting a product, service, or event.
example_en: I saw an interesting advert for a new job in the newspaper.
example_uz: Gazetada yangi ish o'rni uchun qiziqarli reklama ko'rib qoldim.

definition_en: To have something as your own or to hold a specific quality.
example_en: Successful leaders often possess the ability to listen to others carefully.
example_uz: Muvaffaqiyatli rahbarlar ko'pincha boshqalarni diqqat bilan tinglash qobiliyatiga ega bo'ladilar.

definition_en: Designed to protect someone or something from being attacked or harmed.
example_en: He took a defensive tone when his boss criticized his recent work.
example_uz: Boshlig'i uning so'nggi ishini tanqid qilganda, u himoyaviy holatga o'tdi.

definition_en: Not allowed; something that you are officially told not to do.
example_en: It is strictly forbidden to use your mobile phone during the exam.
example_uz: Imtihon paytida mobil telefondan foydalanish qatʼiyan taqiqlangan.

definition_en: Something that is basic, standard, or has no special or unusual features.
example_en: The software comes in a vanilla version without any extra tools.
example_uz: Dastur hech qanday qo‘shimcha vositalarsiz oddiy holatda taqdim etiladi.

definition_en: To hit someone on their bottom with an open hand as a punishment.
example_en: In the past, some parents used to spank children when they misbehaved.
example_uz: Ilgari ba'zi ota-onalar bolalar sho'xlik qilganda ularni shapatilashardi.

definition_en: A person who works in a professional field like medicine or law.
example_en: She is a highly respected practitioner in the field of family law.
example_uz: U oilaviy huquq sohasida juda hurmatli mutaxassis hisoblanadi.

definition_en: Feeling enthusiastic and eager to work hard to achieve a goal.
example_en: We are looking for a highly motivated person for this new role.
example_uz: Biz ushbu yangi lavozim uchun g'ayratli nomzod qidirmoqdamiz.

definition_en: Having an empty space inside rather than being solid.
example_en: The old tree had a large hollow space inside the trunk.
example_uz: Qari daraxtning tanasi ichi katta kovak edi.

definition_en: A secure room, usually made of steel, used for keeping valuables safe.
example_en: The bank manager locked the gold bars in the underground vault.
example_uz: Bank menejeri oltin quymalarni yer ostidagi omborga qulflab qo'ydi.

definition_en: In a way that is fixed firmly or not likely to fail.
example_en: Please ensure that your seatbelt is fastened securely before we takeoff.
example_uz: Uchishdan oldin xavfsizlik kamaringizni mahkam taqib olganingizga ishonch hosil qiling.

definition_en: A long, thin cut or hole in a hard surface.
example_en: The wheels of the toy car fit perfectly into the wooden groove.
example_uz: O'yinchoq mashina g'ildiraklari yog'ochdagi ariqchaga bemalol joylashadi.

definition_en: The surprising and previously secret fact that has been made known to people.
example_en: The revelation of his secret plan shocked everyone in the meeting room.
example_uz: Uning sirli rejasi oshkor bo'lgani majlisdagi barchani hayratda qoldirdi.

definition_en: The act of trying to achieve or find something over a long period.
example_en: He left his job in pursuit of a career as an artist.
example_uz: U rassomlik faoliyatini boshlash ilinjida ishidan ketdi.

definition_en: A group of people chosen to represent others at a meeting or an event.
example_en: The American delegation arrived at the conference early this morning.
example_uz: Amerika delegatsiyasi konferensiyaga bugun erta tongda yetib keldi.

definition_en: The quality of being open and honest, allowing people to see how something works.
example_en: The company promised more transparency in all its financial dealings.
example_uz: Kompaniya barcha moliyaviy ishlarida shaffoflikni ta'minlashga va'da berdi.

definition_en: Having no limit or end; lasting for a very long time.
example_en: We had an endless meeting that lasted for more than five hours.
example_uz: Besh soatdan ortiq davom etgan tugamas majlisda o‘tirdik.
